rows.label: Self-employed: FAK contribution
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: administration costs (VK)
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: total AHV/IV/FAK/VK
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: fixed minimum contribution per year when income is below CHF 3,000
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: unemployment insurance
rows.value: None: the self-employed pay no ALV contributions
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Self-employed: occupational pension (second pillar)
rows.value: Voluntary: they may join their employees' fund or a collective foundation, paying the full contribution

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Flat-rate or simplified income-tax regime
rows.value: No flat income-tax regime; VAT net tax rate method up to CHF 5,024,000 turnover and CHF 108,000 tax

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: VAT registration threshold (turnover per year)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Residence permit for self-employment: EEA and Swiss nationals
rows.value: Short-stay permit (up to 1 year) or residence permit if the professional and trade requirements for self-employment are met and commuting is not reasonable; permit numbers are capped and many are allocated by lottery
rows.source_title: PFZG Art. 10, 15, 16; PFZV Art. 23 to 27; Ausländergesetz (AuG) Art. 13 to 30

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Residence permit for self-employment: other nationals
rows.value: No permit for setting up as self-employed: work permits require a Liechtenstein employer's application (managers, specialists and qualified staff only); people already holding a residence or settlement permit may become self-employed
rows.source_title: PFZG Art. 10, 15, 16; PFZV Art. 23 to 27; Ausländergesetz (AuG) Art. 13 to 30

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Where to apply
rows.value: Ausländer- und Passamt (Immigration and Passport Office), Vaduz
rows.source_title: PFZG Art. 10, 15, 16; PFZV Art. 23 to 27; Ausländergesetz (AuG) Art. 13 to 30

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad or freelance visa
rows.value: None: there is no permit for remote work for a foreign employer or client

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Tax residence test (SteG Art. 2 and 6)
rows.value: Domicile in Liechtenstein, or habitual abode: any continuous stay of more than 6 months (from the first day); stays for education, care or holidays up to 12 months do not count
rows.source_title: Finanzgesetz 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Art. 2 and 3; SteG Art. 2, 6, 23; tax treaties with CH and AT, Art. 15

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Taxation of new residents and permit holders
rows.value: Residents are taxed on worldwide income and wealth; income and wealth from foreign real estate and foreign permanent establishments are exempt (progression reserved); there is no exemption period for other foreign income

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Social security of residents and people working in Liechtenstein
rows.value: Compulsory AHV/IV/FAK for everyone resident or working in Liechtenstein (AHVG Art. 34)
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Social-security agreements (note)
rows.value: For EEA or EFTA nationals in a case limited to the EEA or EFTA area, Regulations (EC) 883/2004 and 987/2009 decide which state insures a person; there is no single agreement covering Liechtenstein, Switzerland and Austria together, so a case involving all three is split by state of work

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Inbound regime: lump-sum taxation (Besteuerung nach dem Aufwand)
rows.value: On application, for foreign nationals taking up residence for the first time or after 10 years abroad who do not work in Liechtenstein: 25% of annual living expenditure instead of income and wealth tax; Liechtenstein real estate stays subject to wealth tax; no time limit and no application deadline

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Inbound regime for employees or experts
rows.value: None: incoming employees are taxed under the ordinary rules (the lump-sum regime excludes gainful activity in Liechtenstein)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Non-residents: tax on employment income
rows.value: Final source deduction set by the Steuerverwaltung; ordinary assessment at the national tariff from CHF 211,400 gross pay (or on request), with a 150% surcharge in 2026
rows.source_title: Finanzgesetz 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Art. 2 and 3; SteG Art. 2, 6, 23; tax treaties with CH and AT, Art. 15

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Cross-border commuters from Austria: Liechtenstein source tax
rows.note: the commuter is taxed in Austria, the state of residence
rows.source_title: Finanzgesetz 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Art. 2 and 3; SteG Art. 2, 6, 23; tax treaties with CH and AT, Art. 15

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Cross-border commuters from Switzerland
rows.value: Taxed only in Switzerland; commuter status lapses after more than 45 working days a year without returning home for work reasons
rows.source_title: Finanzgesetz 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Art. 2 and 3; SteG Art. 2, 6, 23; tax treaties with CH and AT, Art. 15

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Income and wealth tax (national tax) (Vermögens- und Erwerbssteuer (Landessteuer))
rows.value: 0% to 8%; tax-free up to CHF 15,855 (single parents CHF 23,783, couples CHF 31,710)
rows.note: National; paid by: Residents (worldwide income plus a 4% notional yield on net wealth); non-residents on Liechtenstein income; legal basis: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 6 to 22, LR 640.0

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Municipal surcharge on income and wealth tax (Gemeindezuschlag)
rows.value: 150% to 250% of the national tax (150% or 160% for tax year 2025)
rows.note: Municipal; paid by: Residents and non-residents with Liechtenstein real estate or a permanent establishment (not on the source deduction); legal basis: SteG Art. 75 to 77

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Other surcharges on income tax (solidarity, health or defence levies) (—)
rows.value: None: the only surcharge on the national tax is the municipal surcharge (and the 150% surcharge for non-residents assessed ordinarily)
rows.note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 1, 23 Abs. 5 and 75

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Church tax (Kirchensteuer)
rows.value: None: the State pays the Roman Catholic Church an annual contribution of CHF 300,000
rows.note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: LR 181.0 Art. 1 and 2; SteG Art. 1
rows.source_title: Gesetz über die Ausrichtung von Beiträgen an die römisch-katholische Landeskirche

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Capital gains of individuals (shares, movable and immovable private assets) (Kapitalgewinne)
rows.value: Exempt from income tax; gains on Liechtenstein land are taxed by the real-estate gains tax
rows.note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 15 Abs. 2 Bst. m and o

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Real-estate gains tax (Grundstücksgewinnsteuer)
rows.value: Income-tax tariff (Art. 19 Bst. a) on the gain, plus a 200% surcharge instead of the municipal surcharge
rows.note: National; paid by: Seller of Liechtenstein land; legal basis: SteG Art. 35 to 43

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties (Couponsteuer (aufgehoben))
rows.value: None: coupon tax abolished from 2011 (only pre-2011 reserves); dividends exempt from income tax
rows.note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 15 Abs. 2 Bst. n, 24, 157 Ziff. 5 and 158

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Rental income and pension income (Vermögensertrag, Renten)
rows.value: Rent: not taxed (the 4% notional yield on the property is); AHV/IV pensions 30% taxable; occupational pensions in full
rows.note: National; paid by: Residents; legal basis: SteG Art. 14 Abs. 2 Bst. e, 15 Abs. 1 Bst. a and 16 Abs. 2 Bst. d

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (Quellensteuer / Steuerabzug)
rows.value: Final withholding; ordinary assessment from CHF 211,400 (150% surcharge in 2026); Austrian commuters 4%; Swiss commuters exempt
rows.note: National; paid by: Non-resident employees (withheld by the employer); legal basis: SteG Art. 23 to 25; Finanzgesetz 2026 Art. 2 and 3; DBA CH and DBA AT Art. 15 Abs. 4
rows.source_title: Finanzgesetz vom 7. November 2025 für das Jahr 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Social insurance contributions (old age and survivors, invalidity, family compensation, unemployment) (AHV / IV / FAK / ALV)
rows.value: Employee 4.9% AHV/IV/FAK + 0.5% ALV; employer 7.385% AHV/IV/FAK/VK + 0.5% ALV (ALV up to CHF 126,000)
rows.note: National; paid by: Employees and employers; the self-employed (no ALV); legal basis: AHVG, IVG, FZEG, ALVG
rows.source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beitragsansätze AHV / IV / FAK / VK (gültig ab 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Employer-only levies: family compensation fund, administration costs, health-insurance contribution, occupational accident premiums (FAK, Verwaltungskosten, Arbeitgeberbeitrag OKP, BU-Prämie)
rows.value: FAK 1.9%; VK 0.585%; health contribution CHF 180.50 a month per adult employee (2026); accident premiums
rows.note: National; paid by: Employers; legal basis: FZEG Art. 45; KVG Art. 24 Abs. 8; UVersG Art. 79

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Self-employed contributions (AHV/IV/FAK Selbständigerwerbende)
rows.value: 12.285% (AHV 8.25%, IV 1.35%, FAK 2.1%, VK 0.585%); CHF 368.55 minimum below CHF 3,000 income; no ALV
rows.note: National; paid by: Self-employed; legal basis: AHVG Art. 41 and 43

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Mandatory occupational pension (second pillar) (Betriebliche Personalvorsorge (BPVG))
rows.value: At least 8% of the insured wage for old age, from an annual wage of CHF 14,700
rows.note: National; paid by: Employers (at least half) and employees; legal basis: BPVG Art. 4 and 7
rows.source_title: Gesetz über die betriebliche Personalvorsorge (BPVG) (version of 01.01.2026)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Corporate income tax (Ertragssteuer)
rows.value: 12.5%; minimum tax CHF 1,800 (credited); top-up tax for large groups under the minimum-taxation law
rows.note: National; paid by: Legal persons; legal basis: SteG Art. 1 Abs. 2, 61 and 62

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Municipal business or profit tax (—)
rows.value: None: the municipal surcharge applies only to the income and wealth tax; municipalities receive a share of the national corporate tax
rows.note: Municipal; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 75 Abs. 1; Finanzgesetz 2026 budget line 920.352.02
rows.source_title: Finanzgesetz vom 7. November 2025 für das Jahr 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Landesvoranschlag; SteG Art. 75

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Simplified or flat-rate regime for small businesses (Saldosteuersatzmethode (MWST))
rows.value: No flat income-tax regime; VAT net tax rate method up to CHF 5,024,000 turnover and CHF 108,000 tax
rows.note: National; paid by: Small VAT-registered businesses (optional); legal basis: SteG Art. 14 Abs. 2 Bst. b and c, 16 Abs. 1 Bst. b; MWSTG Art. 37

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Formation duty and insurance premium levy (Liechtenstein, where Swiss stamp law does not apply) (Gründungsabgabe, Abgabe auf Versicherungsprämien)
rows.value: 1% of capital above a CHF 1 million exemption (0.5% above CHF 5 million, 0.3% above CHF 10 million); foundations 0.2%, minimum CHF 200
rows.note: National; paid by: Companies, foundations; insurers; legal basis: SteG Art. 66 to 69

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Swiss federal stamp duties (issue duty, securities transfer duty, insurance premium duty) (Eidgenössische Stempelabgaben)
rows.value: Issue duty 1%; transfer duty 0.15% or 0.3%; insurance premiums 5% (2.5% single-premium life)
rows.note: Swiss federal (customs treaty); paid by: Companies issuing shares; securities dealers; insurers (passed on to policyholders); legal basis: Swiss Stempelabgabengesetz (SR 641.10), applicable in Liechtenstein (LGBl. 2026 Nr. 315)
rows.source_title: ESTV: Die eidgenössischen Stempelabgaben (Stand 1. Januar 2024); Kundmachung LGBl. 2026 Nr. 315

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Value added tax (Mehrwertsteuer (MWST))
rows.value: 8.1% standard; 2.6% reduced; 3.8% accommodation
rows.note: National; paid by: Businesses with turnover of CHF 100,000 or more; consumers bear it; legal basis: MWSTG Art. 10 and 25; VAT treaty with Switzerland

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Regional or municipal sales tax (—)
rows.value: None: VAT is the only general consumption tax; municipalities levy only the surcharge on income and wealth tax and fees
rows.note: Municipal; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 1 and 75; MWSTG

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Excise duties (tobacco, beer, spirits, mineral oil) and automobile tax on imported cars (Tabaksteuer, Biersteuer, Spirituosensteuer, Mineralölsteuer, Automobilsteuer)
rows.value: Swiss federal rates; automobile tax 4% of the vehicle value
rows.note: Swiss federal (customs treaty); paid by: Importers and manufacturers (passed on in prices); legal basis: SR 641.31, 641.411, 641.51, 641.61, 680 (applicable under the customs treaty, LGBl. 2026 Nr. 312)
rows.source_title: BAZG: Automobilsteuer; BAZG: Interneteinkauf: Steuern und Abgaben; Kundmachung LGBl. 2026 Nr. 312

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: CO2 levy on heating and process fuels (CO2-Abgabe)
rows.value: CHF 120 per tonne of CO2
rows.note: National; paid by: Producers and importers of fossil heating fuels; legal basis: CO2-Gesetz (LR 814.065) Art. 3; CO2-Verordnung Art. 5

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Property tax (land and buildings) (—)
rows.value: No separate property tax: real estate is part of taxable wealth (valued at income value, at least the tax valuation) and taxed through the 4% notional yield
rows.note: National; paid by: Owners (through the wealth tax); legal basis: SteG Art. 9 and 12 Abs. 2

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Property transfer charges (Grundbuchgebühr (Eigentumsübertragung))
rows.value: No transfer tax; land-register fee 6‰ of the price (minimum CHF 200); mortgage registration 2‰
rows.note: National; paid by: Buyer (land register entry); legal basis: Grundbuch- und Handelsregistergebührenverordnung (GbHr-GebV), LR 214.011

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Wealth tax (Vermögenssteuer (Sollertrag))
rows.value: 4% of net wealth is added to taxable income (notional yield) and taxed at the income-tax rate, plus the municipal surcharge
rows.note: National; paid by: Residents; legal basis: SteG Art. 5, 9 to 12 and 14 Abs. 2 Bst. l

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Tax on transfers to non-exempt foundations and similar structures (Widmungssteuer)
rows.value: 3.5% of the wealth-tax value of the transfer
rows.note: National; paid by: The person transferring assets; legal basis: SteG Art. 13

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Inheritance, estate and gift tax (Erbschafts- und Schenkungssteuer)
rows.value: None since 2011: inheritances and gifts are not taxed (they add to the recipient's taxable wealth)
rows.note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 1, 15 Abs. 2 Bst. c and 157

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Annual motor vehicle tax (Motorfahrzeugsteuer)
rows.value: Cars from CHF 114.10 a year (by weight); motorcycles CHF 45.65 + CHF 11.40 per 100 ccm
rows.note: National; paid by: Vehicle keepers; legal basis: Motorfahrzeugsteuergesetz, LR 641.51, Art. 11 and 12

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Performance-related heavy vehicle fee (Leistungsabhängige Schwerverkehrsabgabe (LSVA))
rows.value: Per tonne-kilometre; the tariff must lie between 0.6 and 2.5 Rappen (up to 3 Rappen for 40-tonne vehicles)
rows.note: National; paid by: Keepers of heavy goods vehicles; legal basis: Schwerverkehrsabgabegesetz (SVAG), LR 641.81; treaty with Switzerland LR 0.641.891.011
rows.source_title: Gesetz über eine leistungsabhängige Schwerverkehrsabgabe (SVAG) (version of 01.01.2025)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Tourist tax (overnight stays) (Kurtaxe)
rows.value: CHF 3.50 per night in hotels; CHF 2.50 holiday homes; CHF 1.50 campsites
rows.note: National; paid by: Guests (collected by the accommodation provider); legal basis: Verordnung über die Melde- und Taxpflicht bei Beherbergungen (BMTV), LR 935.201.1

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Dog tax (Hundesteuer)
rows.value: CHF 20 to 100 per dog, set by each municipality; double for the second and each further dog (Schaan 2026: CHF 100 and CHF 200)
rows.note: Municipal; paid by: Dog owners; legal basis: Hundegesetz Art. 10c (as quoted by the Schaan council)

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Customs duties and import VAT (Zoll, Einfuhrsteuer (Schweizer Zollgebiet))
rows.value: Swiss tariff (mostly per kg); duty or VAT under CHF 5 not collected; travellers CHF 150 VAT-free
rows.note: Swiss federal (customs treaty); paid by: Importers and travellers; legal basis: Zollvertrag 1923 Art. 1; Swiss Customs Act and Customs Tariff Act (LGBl. 2026 Nr. 312)
rows.source_title: BAZG: Empfangen von Briefen und Paketen

rows.section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
rows.label: Lump-sum taxation for new residents without gainful activity (Besteuerung nach dem Aufwand)
rows.value: 25% of annual living expenditure, instead of income and wealth tax
rows.note: National; paid by: Foreign nationals moving to Liechtenstein who do not work there (on application); legal basis: SteG Art. 30 to 34
